Lena (AE): Quick help — customer Nimbus Analytics needs 10% annual-upfront on a 2yr $300k ARR commit but procurement will only approve three invoices in year1 (40/30/30). Can deal desk approve?
Carlos (Deal Desk): Need PO draft + credit check. Is discount conditional on full Year1 prepay?
Lena (AE): Yes they want discount preserved. PO# NA-2026-77, billing contact billing@nimbus.ai. Proposed dates: 2026-05-01 (40%), 2026-08-01 (30%), 2026-11-01 (30%). Year2 prepaid 2027-05-01.
Rina (Finance): Finance notes extra DSO risk. We can accept if: 1) credit check OK; 2) PO references irrevocable 2yr commitment; 3) legal addendum with acceleration on missed installment. Also require Net30 on invoices.
Sam (Legal): I'll draft addendum. We'll add: 30-day dispute window, 15-day cure then acceleration, and explicit condition that discount applies only if all Year1 invoices are paid per schedule.
Ivy (Solutions): Operational note — we'll withhold advanced caching/throughput boosts until Invoice2 clears to limit cost exposure. Ops to implement feature gates.
Carlos (Deal Desk): Pricing fallback if conditions not met: 6% partial-prepay discount + 50% upfront. Provisional approval: 10% if credit passes + signed PO with commitment + legal addendum.
DealDeskBot: Logged provisional approval ID DD-1840-PROV for NA-2026-77.
Rina (Finance): Soft credit check returned medium risk (late pays noted). Acceptable with holdbacks. We'll require Net30 and collections holdback until Invoice2.
Carlos (Deal Desk): Final decision: APPROVE 10% annual-upfront discount contingent on credit acceptance, signed PO referencing 2yr commitment, signed legal addendum with acceleration + dispute clause, and Finance to set Net30 + holdback. Marking DD-1840-APPROVED.
DealDeskBot: Approval finalized DD-1840-APPROVED. Next: @Lena upload signed PO and execute addendum.
Lena (AE): Uploading docs now and looping customer for signature. Thanks all :raised_hands:
